newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street slides in quiet trade, FOMC worries.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street slides in quiet trade, FOMC worries.

text.p: U.S. blue chip shares extended early morning losses on Tuesday, as uncertain stock and bond markets grew nervous about whether Federal Reserve policy makers meeting today would raise key interest rates.
The Dow industrials were trading off about 74 points to 7155, taking their cues from a weaker bond market. But the Nasdaq composite rose 1.54 points to 1343.

Traders said share volume was light and markets were quiet. Investors were wary, focused on the Federal Open Market Committee, the Fed's policy arm, which is seen announcing a rate decision at around 1415 EDT/1815 GMT, they said.
